text.title: Saimaa ringed seal
text.menu_sub: Dive between islands and surface for air.
text.intro: Swim between islands. Hold Down to dive, Up to surface. Breathe at the surface.
text.hungry: Look underwater for small perch and roach.
text.no_food: No small fish within reach. Explore the water.
text.night_hint: Find a quiet shore or rock to rest.
text.sheltered: You can rest here on the shore.
text.out_of_water: Move slowly across shore and return to the water to hunt.
text.about_looks: A rounded grey seal with pale rings, large dark eyes, whiskers and short flippers. Adults are about 1.3–1.45 metres long.
text.about_food: Small schooling fish. This first game region offers small perch and roach; vendace and smelt are not yet modelled.
text.about_home: Lives only in the Saimaa lake system. Linnansaari is an important seal habitat.
text.about_winter: Stays in Saimaa all year. In winter it uses breathing holes and snow lairs. This first version has diving and shore rest, not snow-lair construction.
text.about_young: Usually one pup is born in a snow lair in late winter. The first version starts as an adult.
text.about_fact: Its ring pattern stays recognisable through life. Observe wild seals from a distance and leave resting places undisturbed.
text.safe_tag: Tag! The fish swims away unharmed.
text.bite: A seal caught up with you!

year.shelter: Rocky shores in open water; snow lairs in winter. First version supports shore rest only.
year.young: One pup in a snow lair in late winter; no baby mode yet.

food.spring: Small schooling fish, including perch, roach, vendace and smelt.
food.summer: Small schooling fish, including perch, roach, vendace and smelt.
food.autumn: Small schooling fish, including perch, roach, vendace and smelt.
food.winter: Small schooling fish, including perch, roach, vendace and smelt.

year.notes: Freshwater, air-breathing resident. 60-second playable dive budget is compressed for the game. No migration, hibernation, human threats or snow-lair simulation in the first version.
